description: This Java interface defines a ContentRepository for storing and managing files and images within the application, including methods for saving, deleting, and fetching files and images, as well as retrieving storage type configurations.

classes.name: ContentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing storage, deletion, and retrieval of files and images in the system.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Saves a file uploaded via InputStream along with a DocumentCommand, returns a String typically representing the file location or identifier.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a file based on its document path.

methods.name: fetchFile
methods.description: Retrieves a file as FileData based on provided DocumentData.

methods.name: saveImage
methods.description: Saves an image from an InputStream or a Base64EncodedImage object, associated with a resource ID and image name, returns the image location or identifier.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image based on its storage location.

methods.name: fetchImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image as FileData based on ImageData.

methods.name: getStorageType
methods.description: Returns the storage type configuration used by the repository.
